newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sweden's Backstrom sees crown/DM debt spread fall.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Backstrom sees crown/DM debt spread fall.

text.p: Swedish central bank chief Urban Backstrom said on Friday he saw no reason why the spread between Swedish government bonds and German bunds should not fall over time.
On Friday, the spread of Swedish nine-year paper over 10-year bunds ranged between 122 and 127 basis points.
"I don't see the reason for that spread, because inflation in Sweden is low," Backstrom said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television after attending the Frankfurt European Banking Congress.
"I see no reasons why the spread shouldn't come down in the future. But of course, history plays a role here," he added.
Capital market investors have traditionally demanded a premium on Swedish securities because of high inflation and devaluations of the crown during the 1980's.
